cohort: 7,094,400 births in the United States from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project Nationwide Inpatient Sample (HCUP-NIS) from 2003 to 2010
finding: Sarcoidosis in pregnancy was rare but associated with increased risks of preeclampsia, eclampsia, venous thromboembolism, premature delivery, cesarean delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Women with sarcoidosis were more likely to have cesarean deliveries.
